name: Simple Loop
description: The primary small reference railway: a 4-section closed loop with no switches. This profile is the deterministic software-development and automated-integration-test layout, the manual WPF FullSimulation layout, and the later physical test-oval validation target on the four prototype amplifiers. Note: the physical binding (real amplifier ModBus addresses 1/3/4/6) is a separate, future, separately-configured input, NOT these simulated amplifierSlave values 1..4.
